label: Town of East Montpelier
header:
# Town of East Montpelier municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 7; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists five East Montpelier Selectboard members: Thomas Brazier, Joseph Brooks, Carl Etnier, Seth Gardner, and Scott Hess.

Town of East Montpelier 176th Annual Report (eastmontpeliervt.org): the officer tables list the same five, with Seth Gardner as Chair and Scott Hess as Vice Chair (printing 'Tom Brazier' and 'Joe Brooks').
Title 24 Appendix V.S.A. chapter 114E (official text, Vermont General Assembly): section 5 provides that the Town Clerk is APPOINTED by the Selectboard.
Town of East Montpelier 176th Annual Report (eastmontpeliervt.org): the appointed-officers table lists Rosie Laquerre as Town Clerk.
Town of East Montpelier official website (eastmontpeliervt.org, current): the town's Town Clerk page confirms Rosie Laquerre as the current Town Clerk.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Rosie Laquerre as Town Clerk of East Montpelier.
Title 24 Appendix V.S.A. chapter 114E (official text, Vermont General Assembly): section 3 provides that the Town Treasurer is APPOINTED by the Selectboard.
Town of East Montpelier 176th Annual Report (eastmontpeliervt.org): the appointed-officers table lists Michele Pallas as Town Treasurer (titled Business Manager).
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Michele Pallas as Town Treasurer of East Montpelier.

offices.title: Collector of Delinquent Taxes
offices.org_name: East Montpelier Collector of Delinquent Taxes

sources.note: Title 24 Appendix V.S.A. chapter 114E (official text, Vermont General Assembly): section 6 provides that the Collector of Delinquent Taxes is APPOINTED by the Selectboard.

Town of East Montpelier 176th Annual Report (eastmontpeliervt.org): the appointed-officers table lists Michele Pallas as Collector of Delinquent Taxes (she also serves as Collector of Current Taxes under the same section, which is not separately modeled).

Town of East Montpelier 176th Annual Report (eastmontpeliervt.org): the 2026 warning's Article 1 placed the Moderator on the ballot, and the town's 2026 Town Meeting page records Michael Duane elected Moderator for 2026.

Town of East Montpelier 176th Annual Report (eastmontpeliervt.org): the officer tables list three elected Listers: Deborah Fillion (re-elected 2026, 3-year term), Ross Hazel (expiring 2027), and Richard Harrington (expiring 2028).

Town of East Montpelier 176th Annual Report (eastmontpeliervt.org): the officer tables list three elected Auditors: Carla Occaso (re-elected 2026, 3-year term; the report prints 'Carla (Neary) Occaso'), Ed Deegan (expiring 2027), and Deborah Fillion (expiring 2028).

Town of East Montpelier 176th Annual Report (eastmontpeliervt.org): the officer tables record that the constable office ceased to be elected by vote of the 2022 Town Meeting and has been appointed by the Selectboard since March 2023; the report's appointee is superseded by the town's current Constables page, which lists the First Constable position as 'TBD' with the town recruiting. Structure only: the seat is recorded vacant, not filled.
Town of East Montpelier official website (eastmontpeliervt.org, current): the Constables page lists 'TBD, First Constable' and states the town is recruiting a constable.

Town of East Montpelier 176th Annual Report (eastmontpeliervt.org): Article 1 of the 2026 warning placed three Planning Commissioner seats (3-year terms) on the ballot, fixing a nine-member elected commission; the town's 2026 Town Meeting page records Clarice Cutler, Alexander Rob, and Rebecca Schrader elected in 2026. The members elected in 2024 and 2025 are not named in the report's tables, so their seats are left unfilled rather than guessed.

offices.title: Justice of the Peace
offices.org_name: East Montpelier Justices of the Peace

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists ten East Montpelier justices of the peace: Janice Aldrich, Virginia "Ginny" Burley, Edward Deegan, Richard "Jez" Harrington, Edith "Edie" Miller, Jamie O'Hare, Rebecca Reed, Charles "Cort" Richardson, Elise Thorsen, and Janice Waterman.

Town of East Montpelier 176th Annual Report (eastmontpeliervt.org): the officer tables list the same ten justices of the peace, elected November 2024. The report's parenthetical party labels are not carried; the Secretary of State listing governs this slate.

jp_election.name: Town of East Montpelier Justice of the Peace Election 2024-11-05

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists ten East Montpelier justices of the peace elected November 5, 2024: Janice Aldrich, Virginia "Ginny" Burley, Edward Deegan, Richard "Jez" Harrington, Edith "Edie" Miller, Jamie O'Hare, Rebecca Reed, Charles "Cort" Richardson, Elise Thorsen, and Janice Waterman. The listing publishes no vote totals or party labels and none are recorded.
Town of East Montpelier 176th Annual Report (eastmontpeliervt.org): the officer tables list the same ten justices of the peace.
